season.evidence: Searched Mountaineers route page and trip reports: early season (June into early July) crosses the frozen lake or a snow finger onto the glacier; from mid-July the lake melts out and the moat and bypass become the problem. Matches stored Jun-Jul. Logged Lynch Glacier ascents cluster Jun-Jul (20 of 27).

otherTracksConsidered.why: Logged Lynch Glacier, summited 2021-07-10 (in season), round trip from the Cathedral Rock trailhead past Peggy's Pond, not the Deception Pass approach our route text describes; no trip report and no track shape to confirm the line onto the glacier. Our route has no Trailhead pin, and the Cathedral start would contradict its stated approach.
Lynch Glacier, 2023-09-16: September is outside Jun-Jul (glacier bare, moat wide).
Lynch Glacier, 2026-06-03, turned back at the saddle.

facts.text: In early June a large cornice can overhang the saddle above the glacier, so the final exit from the snow may need care.

notes: Daniel Glacier / Southeast Slopes already has a track. Many Peakbagger Lynch Glacier ascents start from the Cathedral Rock trailhead via Peggy's Pond, an approach our Lynch route text (Deception Pass) does not describe; the owner may want it added as an alternative. Track 1702146 is a plausible later assignment if so.
